mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase and may increase atazanavir levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, while atazanavir's protease inhibitor activity combined with MAOI effects increases risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonergic complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, use alternative antiretroviral with lower CYP3A4 interaction potential and monitor blood pressure closely with dose adjustments of both agents.
